Problem Statement:
Write a program to search an element in a nearly sorted array using binary search. 
Input Description:
First line: Array elements separated by space.
Second line: Target element. 
Output Description:
Index of the element or -1 if not found. 
Sample Input:
2 1 4 3 6 5 8 7
6 
Sample Output:
4
